eng1.definition: front_end_share is the summed change in the compared requests' hand-off time between the two arms; engine_share is the summed change in their wait after hand-off. The two add to the predicted imposed delay exactly.

pol4.definition: front_end_share is the summed change in the compared requests' hand-off time between the two arms; engine_share is the summed change in their wait after hand-off. The two add to the predicted imposed delay exactly.

candidate_compared_request_set.definition: med_ratio_* is median(|predicted| / |measured|) over trials under the two possible compared-request sets: the episodic stream, which is StudyENG1 section 9's published quantity, and every background kind. If the over-prediction were an artefact of the set, the two columns would differ in the cell that fails.

candidate_per_image_admission_stall.definition: admission_charged_to_the_action_ms_p50 is the per-image admission charge the simulator levies for the ACTION's own images, summed over the steps that admit them. The two `predicted_*_off` columns re-score every cell with both admission coefficients set to zero.

offset_profile_eng1.definition: offset is the compared request's recorded arrival time minus the action's injection time, both relative to the trace start. Sums are over every matched arrival in the bin across all FIT trials of the cell, which is the quantity criterion (i) is built from.

offset_profile_pol4.definition: offset is the compared request's recorded arrival time minus the action's injection time, both relative to the trace start. Sums are over every matched arrival in the bin across all FIT trials of the cell, which is the quantity criterion (i) is built from.

merged_step_eng1.definition: predicted_merged_step_s is the longest simulator step that prefills more than one of the action's requests. measured_shared_span_s is the time from the instant the engine became free (the first token of an action request that finished before the group, or the group's last hand-off if there is none) to the group's shared first-token instant. Both start when the engine was free, and the measured one is a LOWER bound on the engine step that served the group, so a ratio above 1 is the smallest over-charge the record is consistent with.

merged_step_pol4.definition: predicted_merged_step_s is the longest simulator step that prefills more than one of the action's requests. measured_shared_span_s is the time from the instant the engine became free (the first token of an action request that finished before the group, or the group's last hand-off if there is none) to the group's shared first-token instant. Both start when the engine was free, and the measured one is a LOWER bound on the engine step that served the group, so a ratio above 1 is the smallest over-charge the record is consistent with.

token_convention.evidence: StudyENG1 section 2 records an A1 query as 378 tokens at N=1 and about 1,062 at N=3, which is 36 + 342 N; and A2's piece sizes as 256 to 8,192 tokens = 3 to 91 frames, which is 90 tokens per HISTORY frame. The step model's per_encoder_input_ms was fitted on steps whose images were history frames, so it behaves as a per-90-encoder-token rate and the simulator must pass encoder work in those units, not a frame count.

question_2_single_request_base.verdict_note: Under the simulator's own encoder-token convention the single-request base is not under-predicted: Part B's 20 idle-engine solo_ep requests are reproduced at 0.945 of measured and the A1 k=1 cell at 0.996 (N=1). The 0.804 and 0.771 figures the first fit reported were computed with the A1 cells' `N` passed as the image count, which is the query's FRAME count and a quarter of the encoder units the step model prices. There is a real residual at N=3 (ratio 1.138, an OVER-prediction) and a 5.5 % under-prediction at 378 tokens; both are smaller than the cell-to-cell scatter and neither has a measurement isolating its cause, so NO TERM IS ADDED.

comparison.unloaded_rho_part_b: 0.97 to 1.00 at 25 to 75 % of the way through a monolithic 11k prefill (StudyENG1 H-admit verdict a)
comparison.simulator_rho: 1.0 by construction: an arrival waits for the whole of the step that is running, and for a long prefill that is the request's remaining work

question_3_blocking_under_load.not_added: The estimate is REPORTED AND NOT ADDED TO THE MODEL, per the brief. It is computed on the same Part C FIT trials the criterion is scored on, so fitting a blocking coefficient to it and then re-scoring would be circular.
